result.title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
result.summary: Many control tasks require driving the system into a prescribed goal set and subsequently keeping it there. The considered setting assumes that a working controller is available that provably reaches and maintains the goal, albeit with suboptimal performance. This controller is referred to as the fallback policy. Conversely, although state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning (RL) algorithms can discover policies with impressive empirical performance, the neural networks at their core act as opaque black boxes learned through data-driven exploration and, as such, provide no theoretical mechanism to guarantee that the system will ever reach---and stay within---the prescribed goal set. This article presents CALF-Wrapper, a method that combines the fallback policy with a pretrained RL base policy and uses the critic estimate associated with the base policy to select between them during deployment. The theoretical analysis establishes that CALF-Wrapper inherits the goal-reaching property of the fallback policy under the stated assumptions and provides probability bounds for the settling time and the maximum distance from the goal set over a prescribed time interval. The experimental study evaluates CALF-Wrapper in four simulated control environments of different complexity. Comparisons include the base policy, fallback policy, and constrained reinforcement-learning methods formulated for the same objective. Sensitivity and ablation studies provide direct hyperparameter recommendations. The experiments show how CALF-Wrapper can provide effective task performance while attaining the maximum possible observed goal-reaching rate. CALF-Wrapper requires no additional dynamics model, online learning, or constrained optimization during execution.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CALF-Wrapper，将可证明到达并维持在目标集内的 fallback 控制器与预训练 RL 基础策略结合，部署时利用基础策略的 critic 估计在两者间仲裁切换；理论分析给出目标到达性质继承以及稳定时间与偏离目标集最大距离的概率界，并在四个不同复杂度的仿真控制环境中与基础策略、fallback 及约束 RL 方法对比，附灵敏度与消融实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其在「有保证的保守策略」与「经验性能更好的策略」之间用价值估计做在线切换的仲裁思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的模式切换与停止判据、以及推理可靠性保证提供借鉴线索；但需核查其保证是否依赖马尔可夫控制与可达性假设，从而难以迁移到推理状态，属于推测。
